_deal: No deal: started by hand with startquest for his test. Under his 2026-10-21 rule (never edit a shipped quest) the landing lives in a new Delve; a pool is his call once it has played.
author: eliza
source: his 2026-10-21 09:28: "Roll back to the old ESM then build a new delve mission with the landings", after the strike team by ship (A1) on qst11a/b/d was rolled back. His A1: a friendly team lands and holds the entrance.
_note: THE LANDING, FRIENDLY (A1). A clear at a Spacer-held site; when he comes within 300 of the site's B1 travel ring a
UC Security transport comes down there from orbit, opens its ramps, and a UC Marine team steps out of the hatch
and joins the fight (support, papyrus/duo_delve_landing.psc). The hostile twin is Jessica's 28a, Strike: Spacer
Landing, whose crew could arrive the same way. WORDS ARE ELIZA'S PLACEHOLDERS, Jessica's to write; the type word
too (a new type gets its word the day it is written). Pay: med, placeholder.

place._theme: A built site the Spacers have taken: somewhere worth sending a ship for.
